tools.name: bark_zero_ask
tools.title: Ask Bark Zero
tools.description: Ask Bark Zero — a dry British crypto/culture AI personality powered by WALDOGE — a single question and get a punchy reply.

question.description: The question or prompt for Bark Zero.

tools.name: launch_lab_concept
tools.title: Generate token concept
tools.description: Draft a meme-coin concept in Bark Zero's voice — name, ticker, narrative, lore, marketing angles, risk notes. This is IDEATION ONLY. No token is created, deployed, or funded. The Waldoge site owner must explicitly approve any real launch in-app.

theme.description: Theme, narrative or seed idea for the token.

audience.description: Target audience or community. Empty string if none.

tools.name: market_scan
tools.title: Bark Zero market scan
tools.description: Scan the current crypto/attention landscape for narratives (AI, memes, gaming, culture) and return AI-estimated rankings with a score 1-100. Scores are AI-generated estimates, not live market data.

focus.description: Optional focus area, e.g. 'AI agents', 'Solana memes', 'gaming'. Empty string for a general scan.

tools.name: waldoge_info
tools.title: Waldoge project info
tools.description: Return public info about the Waldoge project: mascot, chain, token mint, tier thresholds, and feature list.

topic.description: Optional topic to focus on: 'tiers', 'features', 'mascot', 'token'. Empty string returns everything.
